latin: Siqua est natura immediata nobis quae sit uel simpliciter uel saltem ut multum rationaliter rationalis, magicam habet in summo, et eius participatione potest in hominibus esse perfectior.

translation: If there is any nature immediate to us that is rational either simply, or at least for the most part rationally, it holds magic in its highest degree, and by participation in it magic can be more perfect in men.
